scope: Read-only independent review of actual unmodified render PNGs and ordered raw JPEG frames. No engine run, image synthesis, realtime playback, or physical-input test.
observations_ko: 찌른 방향을 유지하며 검을 곧게 뒤로 빼는 동작으로 읽힘. 기존 비틀기와 우측 베기 동작은 검수 구간에서 보이지 않음.
찌르기와 유지 중 손과 가드가 보이고, 인출하면서 팔은 우하단으로 자연스럽게 빠짐. 소매가 파지를 통째로 가리거나 팔꿈치가 크게 반전하는 현상을 발견하지 못함.
크리프는 인출 도중 움찔한 자세를 유지하며, 측면 clear 이미지에서 검끝과 등 사이 간격이 확인된 뒤 연속 프레임에서 몸이 아래로 쓰러짐.
회복 시 검이 다시 올라오는 것은 검이 몸에서 빠진 뒤이며 추가 베기 동작으로 보이지 않음.
observations_en: The blade reads as a straight pull-out along its established thrust direction; no retained twist or side-slice appeared in the reviewed interval.
Grip and guard remain readable during stab/hold; the arm exits toward the lower right during extraction without gross sleeve occlusion or elbow flipping.
The creature remains in its recoil pose during extraction. The clear-side image shows blade-tip separation, followed by downward collapse in the ordered frames.
The later sword raise occurs after clearance and reads as recovery, not an additional cut.

qualifications: The arm and grip are largely below the first-person frame late in extraction; side PNGs corroborate their pose at the sampled moments, not all-time skin clearance.
The original broad sleeve proportions and previously disclosed finger spacing remain.
Sequential still inspection cannot establish playback smoothness at all speeds or physical-input behavior.
No new exact contact/penetration or clinical-anatomy claim.
